title: Bengal Famine of 1943
note: Catastrophic famine in British Bengal during World War II resulting in an estimated 2 to 3 million civilian deaths, exacerbated by wartime grain requisitioning, military denial policies, and colonial administrative allocation failures.

title: Nanjing Massacre
note: Six-week mass murder and systematic sexual violence against Chinese civilians and disarmed soldiers committed by Imperial Japanese armed forces following the capture of Nanjing on 13 December 1937.

title: Bombing of Darwin
note: Largest foreign attack on Australian territory in modern history, executed by Japanese aircraft on 19 February 1942 targeting military shipping, harbour infrastructure, and civilian facilities in Darwin.

title: Warsaw Uprising
note: Sixty-three-day urban insurrection initiated on 1 August 1944 by the Polish Underground Home Army to liberate Warsaw from German occupation, met with brutal German repression and wholesale city destruction.
